description: Autonomous loop control. Start a repeating task loop, check status, update progress journal, or stop it. The Stop hook drives iteration. Call "update" after each iteration with a brief summary to maintain context across compactions.

action.description: start: begin autonomous loop. stop: end loop. status: check current loop state. update: write iteration journal/progress.

progress.description: Rolling progress summary replacing the previous one. Used with action "update".

session_id.description: Claude Code session ID. Auto-detected if omitted.

summary.description: Brief summary of what this iteration accomplished (1-2 sentences, for journal). Used with action "update".

task.description: What to do each iteration (required for start).

template.description: Load a saved template by name or id. Template values are used as defaults; explicit params override.

name: loop
